A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"bullets\":\"*+-\"}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/1\">a</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">b</a></td><td><a href=\"/3\">c</a></td></tr></table>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
